distribution.summary: 福建；贵州；湖南；江西；四川；西藏；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) records Hunan, Guizhou, Fujian and Xizang under Coptodryas. Smith et al. (2020) confirms those areas and adds Hong Kong, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan and Taiwan under Microperus perparvus. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports the first Taiwan record, including Nantou, Hui Son, 23.ix.2006. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Baseline host set retained: Cinnamomum camphora, Phoebe sp. and Quercus sp. Smith et al. (2020) adds no host in the promoted record. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous, perhaps with preference for Dipterocarpaceae; this broad statement is contextual and adds no host taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Microperus perparvus (Sampson, 1922).

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus tsukubanus
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 195.

taxonomic_history.name: Microperus perparvus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 黄复生等 (2015) source-level scientific name is stored as Coptodryas perρarvus (with Greek rho) and Source Note gives Coptodryas perparva. Current canonical identity is Microperus perparvus (Sampson, 1922), VSN_3697. Beaver & Liu (2010) notes the prior transfer from Coptodryas to Microperus; source-level anomalies remain preserved upstream.
